decisions.reason: The score prominence and heading changes do not alter the separately defined content or bullet-point presentation of the result explanation.
Changing the score's visual prominence and heading does not change which customer fields must remain editable.
The front-page dashboard refinement does not affect the final-page confidentiality warning.
The dashboard score display and heading changes do not alter the independently specified internal-page header.
The broad visual-style requirement already remains valid unchanged; the dashboard-specific refinement does not necessarily change its stored design approach or priorities.
The source dashboard modification does not change footer presentation, coverage, or identifier requirements.
Renaming the score heading to Vehicle Security Score and enlarging the score do not change the RR-01 report identifier rule.
Making the displayed score and risk outcome more prominent does not change the mapping between scores, report variants, risk bands, and exposure levels.
The dashboard presentation change does not alter the required fonts, icons, or reusable design assets for handoff.
The front-page score refinement does not change the required editable formats, report variants, or PDF-export capability.
